constructionRule: During Build, construct up to one Facility, then up to one unlocked project from the same Agent assignment. Pay each cost and check requirements after placing the Facility.

projects.name: ${terms.technology.megaCluster}
projects.text: Spend 3 ${terms.resources.runway} and 2 ${terms.resources.compute} to place a ${terms.technology.megaCluster} across two adjacent connected Facilities you own. Add 2 ${terms.playerTracks.scrutiny}. It produces 3 ${terms.resources.compute} during Production while both hosts remain adjacent and connected. No additional Power is assigned.

projects.name: ${terms.technology.advancedGeneration}
projects.text: Era III onward Build project. On ${terms.locations.grid}, spend ${facts.shared.advancedGeneration.runwayCost} ${terms.resources.runway}. Place the sole shared Fusion chip in a legal Generator slot. It is an additional Generator that connects your Facilities on this or adjacent districts. Score ${facts.shared.advancedGeneration.mandate} ${terms.playerTracks.mandate} and add ${facts.shared.advancedGeneration.scrutiny} ${terms.playerTracks.scrutiny}. Only one Fusion may be built.

projects.name: Quantum
projects.text: Era IV Build project. Assign an Agent to a district with a connected Facility you own; a Facility placed earlier in this Build may qualify. Pay ${content.projects.byId.quantum.runwayCost} Runway and ${content.projects.byId.quantum.computeCost} Compute. Gain ${content.projects.byId.quantum.capabilityGain} Capability, respecting the normal cap and threshold awards, and add ${content.projects.byId.quantum.scrutinyOnBuild} Scrutiny. Mark Quantum completed on your faction board. Once per institution per game; no shared limit and no other project prerequisite. This is an immediate gain, not Production income.
